fact: On 1 November 2026 the Council of Ministers approved three draft bills from the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, including the draft Digital Transformation Regulation Bill 2026; it is a draft, not in force, and the report does not say it provides for data exchange between public bodies.
title: مجلس الوزراء يجيز 3 قوانين جديدة للأمن السيبراني والذكاء الاصطناعي بالسودان
